Cards the [[Players Committee]] '''blanked''': from the blanking date a blanked card is treated as if it did not exist (in effect a ban). It is not a new version of the card; the card stays in its set and is legal in period formats that end before the blanking. The date is the ''Blanked'' field of each card's infobox ([[Template:Card]], parameter <code>blanked</code>).
